verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript library whose product surface is its public JS API. That API is documented through the manual and per-class docs (e.g. GLTFLoader, OrbitControls), shown in README code (WebGLRenderer, setSize), versioned on npm, and published as llms.txt plus a 363 KB llms-full.txt of the complete docs. The OpenAPI 404s don't count against it, since it is not an HTTP service. missing for 10: static per-page doc URLs (human docs are hash-routed), independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
